plugin.name: Shared Pet
plugin.description: Raise one OpenPets companion together across two computers.

serverUrl.label: Sync server
serverUrl.description: Must match a host declared in the plugin manifest.

nickname.label: Default nickname
nickname.description: Optional. Prefills the connection form and is shown only to your paired partner.

inviteCode.label: Default partner invite code
inviteCode.description: Optional. Prefills the connection form; leave empty on the first computer.

showStats.label: Show shared status
showStats.description: Pins mood, energy, fullness and bond beside the pet.

command.connectDescription: Create a room when invite code is empty, otherwise join it.
command.guideDescription: Show the remaining pairing steps for this computer.
command.diagnoseDescription: Check nickname, sync server address, and connection status.

form.inviteCode: Partner invite code (leave empty on the first computer)
